title: Ixora Canonical Smart Home Capability Contract
description: ADR-037 Canonical Smart Home Device Model — Capability/Operation/Constraint. Shared SCHEMA, not shared code (ADR-037 §11): back_vibes (PHP), front_vibes (TypeScript) and the Android plugin (Kotlin) each validate against this artifact in their own idiom. Canonical copy lives in ixora-infra/contracts/smart-home/; this file is the vendored copy back_vibes reads. No provider literal (Home Assistant 0-255, Google Home 0-254, trait or service names) may ever appear in this contract.

contract_version.description: Semver of this contract, accompanying persisted/transmitted data so a consumer can detect which shape it is reading during the transition window (ADR-037 §10). Additive changes are minor; changing an existing constraint's required shape is major.

capabilityId.description: Closed, governed vocabulary (ADR-037 §2). Adding an id is a deliberate amendment to this list, never a string invented by a provider mapper.

operation.description: Canonical verbs, decoupled from any provider's service or command names (ADR-037 §3). `toggle` is first-class regardless of whether a provider implements it natively or as a composed read-invert-write.

access.description: A capability is something you can read, something you can command, or both — there is no third category (ADR-037 §2).

constraints.description: Null only when a capability has genuinely no associated value. No capability in the v1 catalog does — `power` carries {type: boolean} rather than null (ADR-037 §4, PO correction 2).

constraint.description: Closed tagged union (ADR-037 §4). Extended by adding a case, never by loosening an existing one.

min.description: null means NOT KNOWN — never 'unbounded', never zero (ADR-037 §4).

max.description: null means NOT KNOWN for min/step; for max specifically, null is also how 'unbounded' is expressed (e.g. energy). Disambiguated per capability by the catalog, not by the schema.

step.description: null means NOT KNOWN — resolution undeclared by the provider.

unit.description: Mandatory unconditionally. A numeric value with a genuinely unknown unit is not representable by this model (ADR-037 §4).

x-catalog.description: Per-capability rules the JSON Schema vocabulary alone cannot express: which operations each capability admits, which constraint type it must carry, and its canonical unit. PHP/Kotlin/TS validators read this to enforce the closed catalog. Concrete min/max/step are per-device and supplied by each provider mapper — EXCEPT brightness, whose 0-100/percent range is fixed by ADR-037 §5 and is not a mapper's choice.
